text:
Alex: FYI we're blocked on a reserved capacity request for an 8x A100 pool in us-west-2. Waitlist UI shows about 6 weeks. This blocks the Dedicated trial for acme-profiles. can we escalate?

Mona: @Alex do we know the commitment term they requested? 6mo vs 12mo affects sourcing options.

Alex: 6 months, planned start May 1. They need steady 200 rps at peak; can't rely on spot bursting. :confused:

Tim: looping in infra sourcing. Quick question: any idle reserved pools we can temporarily reassign?

Tim: try `rictl capacity list --region us-west-2 --class a100 --status idle` to show candidates.

Alex: pasted output from that command:
```
pool-id  size  allocated_to     status
p-2112   4     team-dataflow    in-use
p-2113   8     team-vision      idle
p-2114   16    team-analytics   in-use
```

Alex: team-vision's 8 GPUs are idle this week, but they're under a billing tag `vision-commit` and a long-term reserved contract.

Mona: reassigning a tagged reserved pool will cause billing adjustments and needs finance sign-off. @Priya can you estimate untagging/transfer delta? :eyes: 

Priya: short answer: transfer triggers a prorated reserved adjustment. For a 6-month swap the one-time delta is roughly $12k. But moving acme to that pool would reduce their monthly run cost ~18% for the trial.

Priya: finance also says a 3-month temporary swap and re-tagging afterward is possible but manual heavy-lift. We'll need documentation.

Tim: infra-bot: `queue-length: 24 requests; avg-leadtime: 38 days; high-priority: 3` (pulled from capacity-queue API).

infra-bot: note: reservation_api returned 429 for req 0x9f12 at 2024-11-07T15:04:02Z; auto-retry scheduled +30m.

Alex: I already opened cloud support case 987654321. Their initial reply: no immediate capacity, but estimate 9-12 days to recycle previously reserved nodes in us-west-2.

Mona: 9-12 days is better than 6 weeks. Can we stitch together a short-term bridge (spots or partner capacity) until recycled capacity shows up? Cost estimate?

Priya: spot bridge estimated +30% run cost vs reserved. For acme's projected load that's about +$4.2k for 2 weeks. That's cheaper than $12k contract churn.

Tim: other option: run the trial out of us-east-1 where we currently have slack. That adds ~20-40ms RTT; will the acme demo tolerate it?

Alex: they insisted on us-west for data residency; extra latency could invalidate demo SLAs.

Mona: proposed hybrid plan:
- Provision spot bridge for ~10 days (ops)
- Ask sourcing to attempt temporary reallocation of p-2113 with minimal billing churn (finance to evaluate)
- Partnerships/sales to press vendor support for faster fulfillment (open vendor SLA appeal)

Alex: I can stand up the spot bridge once finance signs off. Who owns the approval flow?

Priya: finance will triage. I need the acme cost center and PID. DM me and I'll start approval. I can pre-authorize up to $15k OOB for emergency pool swaps pending PM ok.

Tim: I can prepare the reassign command but it will be gated: `rictl reassign --pool p-2113 --target reserved --note \"acme-trial-urgency\"`. Will wait for finance token.

Mona: I'll open INC-4321 internal incident and escalate to partnerships to request priority lane with the cloud provider.

infra-bot: ticket created - INC-4321 assigned to partnerships, priority P1, created by Mona at 2024-11-07T15:22:10Z.

Tim: FYI last quarter we had a billing mismatch when we re-tagged a reserved pool; invoice line `ReservedCapacity_Adjustment` showed up and finance took ~2 cycles to reconcile. Flagging so Priya can plan cash flow.

Priya: noted, thanks. I'll include that in the approval docs.

Mona: please react with :+1: if you agree to the spot-bridge + finance-eval path.

Alex: +1

Tim: +1

Priya: +1

Mona: action items (summary):
- Alex: provision spot bridge and post cost breakdown (in progress)
- Priya: start finance approval for potential pool transfer (in progress)
- Tim: prep `rictl` reassign flow and standby for finance token (blocked)
- Mona: escalate to partnerships + file vendor SLA appeal (in progress)

Alex: I'll update when the spot nodes are provisioned. Demo scheduled May 8.

Mona: fallback plan if vendor SLA appeal is denied:
1) request a demo extension from acme,
2) offer us-east with encrypted cross-region egress as mitigation,
3) last resort: accept contract churn and do the reassign. Prefer to avoid step 3.

Alex: thanks everyone. closing thread for now, will post status updates as they come. :thumbsup:
